Plugin.Name: Corsair PSU Center
Plugin.Overview:
An iCUE-style dashboard and fan control for Corsair HXi and RMi digital power supplies.
Corsair's iCUE software is Windows-only, so a Corsair digital PSU in an Unraid server normally means no monitoring and no fan control at all. This adds both, in its own tab.
MONITORING - live per-rail voltage, current and power for +12V, +5V and +3.3V; total power out, estimated power in, efficiency and load; VRM and case temperatures; fan RPM. Every reading carries a running min/max and a live sparkline. Sensors are read from the kernel corsair-psu hwmon driver, so polling costs no USB traffic and cannot collide with other software.
FAN CONTROL - hand the fan to the PSU firmware (zero-RPM idle), hold a fixed duty, or build a custom curve with a drag-and-drop editor mapping VRM temperature to fan duty. Presets for Quiet, Balanced, Performance and Max.
+12V OCP - switch between single-rail and multi-rail overcurrent protection. Single rail uses one combined threshold for the whole +12V output, which means fewer nuisance trips when several drives spin up at once.
The PSU model is detected automatically. Supported: HX750i, HX850i, HX1000i, HX1000i (2022), HX1200i, HX1200i ATX 3.1, HX1500i, RM650i, RM750i, RM850i, RM1000i. An unrecognised Corsair digital PSU still reports every sensor the kernel exposes and keeps fan control; only efficiency and load percentage are hidden, since those need model-specific data.
Self-contained - bundles every Python module it needs, so there is nothing to install by hand and no internet access required at boot.
Note: these PSUs cannot store a fan curve in firmware, so custom curves are driven from Unraid by a small background service, exactly as iCUE does on Windows. Minimum fan duty is 30%.
Tested on real hardware with an HX1000i. The other models share the same detection path but are untested - reports welcome.
